constraints.note: Mike's per-run brief: 5 clips maximum, every clip under 60 s FINAL runtime. Applied as 5 topics x 1 full clip each, no impact variants (the 5-clip cap is consumed by 5 distinct topics; with every full already under a minute an impact cut would be redundant). Raw spans are planned at 56-62 s with the dead-air spans listed per clip in notes so Phase 5 tighten lands each at roughly 45-52 s. Clip 3 is the only one over 60 s raw (62.2 s) and carries ~18 s of identified dead air. Selection doctrine: hype/conviction/project first; all FOMC / rate-hike / chart-analog market talk dropped (stale after Oct 28, ordinary stream talk per topic-finding SKILL.md 2026-08-13 hardening).

topics.hook_summary: KCC1, KCC2 and KCC20 are now final, ready for full adoption across the ecosystem. The tokens are etched into the L1, not through a third-party indexer. There's no reason to say KCC20 anymore: now we just say Kaspa tokens, the way you say Solana tokens. Pump it up again, hell yeah.

This could be your last chance to get in on all these assets. We might have an insane bull run right now bigger than anything the world has ever experienced, not just crypto. Going forward it could be like feudalism: insanely difficult to get ahead and grow a business if you don't have assets, because everything is so goddamn cheap.

Claude Code completely replaces software engineers. Anthropic's engineers, among the highest caliber on the planet, paid 500 to 800 thousand a year, say AI now codes better than them. Engineers do nothing but review AI code, and now agents review the code. Entire jobs are being wiped out this year; radiology as we speak.

We're not far off from ships going into asteroids and mining gold, which plummets the value of gold. China is buying a whole bunch of gold while the United States shifts the backing of the dollar from oil to the stablecoin. If gold gets devalued dramatically, the countries hoarding gold right now are gonna be out a lot.

Longevity escape velocity is probably reached within the next five years: as you age a year you gain back more than a year. If a 90-year-old has the health of a 50-year-old, social security completely collapses. Maybe the powers that be foresee it: Trump accounts, kids getting stocks, so kids alive now have assets and there's no need for social security.

clips.title: KCC20 Is Final: Kaspa Memes Are Just Kaspa Tokens Now

segments.why: HOOK, cold on the announcement he reads off the KCC Coordination Forum post: 'KCC1, KCC2, and KCC20 are now final. Meaning they are ready for full adoption across the ecosystem.'

What it is, for the viewer who never heard of it: 'KCC20, in case you do not know, it is the token standard built on covenants'. Ends before the redundant 'it was just released a month or two ago' aside.
The substance: 'the tokens that are just etched into the L1 rather than through a third party indexer, which is your Kasplex, right? So the tokens are now on an L1'.

The payoff, 18 min later in the stream: 'no reason to start saying KCC20 now, because it's a protocol. Now we can just say Kaspa tokens. The same way we say how do you buy Solana tokens, how do you buy ETH tokens. Now we can just really call them Kaspa.'
CLOSER, pulled back from the 3:30 run so the short ends on the energy: 'so yeah, pump it up again, right? Hell yeah.'

peak_beats.note: 'KCC1, KCC2, and KCC20 are now final' - the scroll-stop for every Kaspa holder
'Now we can just say Kaspa tokens... the same way we say Solana tokens' - the conceptual punch

clips.notes: Emotional core = segment 4 ('pump it up again, hell yeah', 3:30-3:37; the falling-Kaspa-coins stream FX is on screen around 1:35 and 2:10 too) plus the flat-delivered but hard-hitting 'are now final' hook. Assembly is narrative, not chronological: announcement -> what it is -> why it matters (L1, no indexer) -> 'they're just Kaspa tokens now' (21:42) -> back to 3:30 for the 'hell yeah' out. Segments 1 and 2 are the same run with the 3:08.4-3:13.3 aside excised ('It was just released like a month or two ago, covenants,'); the join reads '...built on covenants, and it's basically the tokens that are just etched into the L1'.
